changelog: Stock deduction is now fast and responsive even on large orders: Apply and Deduct no longer freezes, shows live progress, and every button in the stock screens stays responsive. Deductions only apply when there is enough stock to fully cover an item, so you never go below what you actually have. Update handling is more reliable too: the app no longer reports you are up to date when it could not reach the server, the update banner now appears from a manual check, and the app restarts automatically after an update installs.
